description: Base de données sur les mouvements de terrain recensés sur le littoral de la Côte Rocheuse aquitaine - mise à jour du 22/05/2019 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Census of field movements observed in the field or obtained in the archives (DDE, newspapers, design offices, …). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Database on the land movements recorded on the coast of the Aquitaine Rocky Coast - update of 22/05/2019" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include risques, aléa, géologie, littoral_oca, littoral aquitain, mouvement de terrain. The listing shows 2019-05-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
